technique_name: Describe what AI technology has enabled people to do.
description: AI technology has enabled people to do a variety of tasks faster, more efficient and with greater accuracy. AI has enabled autonomous cars, virtual assistants, predictive analytics, natural language processing, voice recognition, and facial recognition technology – just to name a few. AI has also improved healthcare, financial services, education, and advertising. AI helps make decisions, take actions, and offer personalized experiences, ultimately boosting productivity and cutting costs. Additi
